exceptions.reason: The base sets module ESNext and moduleResolution bundler, not NodeNext: Vite bundles the client and Node strips types and runs shared/ source directly, and the file's own comment says why.
Relative imports end in .ts, not .js (allowImportingTsExtensions), because Node runs shared/ source directly under type stripping.
Two stylesheets on purpose: noHexColors.test.ts and contrast.test.ts read tokens.css as the one file that holds colour, so it stays apart from index.css, which holds the document-level base rules.
The second of the two stylesheets: the base layer and the dark: variant. tokens.css is the colour file the tests read, so the two stay separate.
A translucent mix of two tokens (color-mix over var(--token)) that no utility names; the colours still come from tokens.css and noHexColors.test.ts keeps literals out.
